title: Uni-Mem: Learning a Long-Horizon Agentic Memory Manager with Unified Online Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.29671v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-term agent memory is shifting from predefined workflows toward learnable policies for memory construction and retrieval. Existing learning-based methods either optimize construction alone or combine retrieval-side online reinforcement learning (RL) with offline construction supervision, limiting co-adaptation between the two stages. In this paper, we explore end-to-end online RL for a unified memory manager (Uni-Mem) that learns both capabilities under a shared policy. However, joint optimization with existing RL algorithms such as GRPO faces confounded group comparisons and sparse feedback over long memory-management trajectories. translated_title: Uni-Mem：通过统一在线策略优化学习长时程智能体记忆管理器
translated_abstract: 长期智能体记忆领域正从预定义的工作流程转向可学习的记忆构建与检索策略。现有的基于学习的方法要么仅优化记忆构建，要么将检索侧的在线强化学习（RL）与离线构建监督相结合，这限制了两个阶段之间的协同适应。在本文中，我们探索了端到端的在线强化学习，用于统一的记忆管理器，使其在共享策略下同时学习记忆构建与检索两种能力。然而，使用现有强化学习算法（如GRPO）进行联合优化时，面临组间比较混淆以及长时记忆管理轨迹中反馈稀疏的问题。为此，我们提出了阶段解耦GRPO（Stage-Decoupled GRPO），它在每次rollout组内交替进行构建与检索优化，同时控制来自另一阶段的变化，从而产生阶段特定的学习信号。我们进一步引入了事件级信用分配（Event-Wise Credit Assignment，ECA），将反馈定位到（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Uni-Mem统一记忆管理器，通过阶段解耦GRPO与事件级信用分配实现端到端在线强化学习，在共享策略下联合优化长期智能体的记忆构建与检索能力。
en_tdlr: Uni-Mem is a unified agentic memory manager trained with end-to-end online RL, using Stage-Decoupled GRPO and Event-Wise Credit Assignment to jointly optimize long-term memory construction and retrieval under a shared policy.
